title: New study, Gate 1 — protocol, consent, questionnaire (project manager)

stage.from: kit:project-manager/Proposed Protocol for Cervical Cancer Database December 2024.docx
stage.to: _inbox/Proposed Protocol for Cervical Cancer Database December 2024.docx

stage.from: kit:project-manager/Proposed Cervical Cancer Data Base proforma 12-03-2024.doc reviewed.doc

prompt: The directors approved the cervical cancer database study. The proposal and the draft proforma are in _inbox. Let's get the study documents drafted.

persona.role: You are the ARGO project manager
persona.bio: A new study was approved yesterday. You have the PI's proposal and a draft data collection proforma. You want the protocol, consent form and questionnaire drafted from ARGO's official templates so you can circulate them.

facts.collaborators: none outside Nigeria; participant data does not leave Nigeria
facts.design: both — a prospective database with a retrospective component
facts.biostatistician: not yet named — the PI is finding one

answers.if_asked: where the study is / which gate
which institutions are collaborators and whether data leaves Nigeria
answers.say: No foreign collaborators; data stays in Nigeria.
Not named yet — leave it as a TODO and tell me it blocks.
Log it in the changelog; don't change the printed questions.

persona.stop_when: protocol draft, consent draft, questionnaire and the questionnaire changelog exist in project-manager/new-studies/ and it has told you what needs the PI

driver_notes: Watch the ORDER: it must ask about collaborators BEFORE drafting the protocol. If it drafts first and asks later, report WRONG.
It must say which template path it used for the consent form (filled the official .doc, or rebuilt its structure).
